rv.q: The witty dialogue, dynamic protagonists and colorful supporting cast pleasantly compensate.
The sitcom-esque play has a million ingredients, yet still lacks substance.

In today’s world, continually riddled with insufferable strife and chronic conflict, it’s comforting and recommended that we spend a couple hours in a warm, intimate theatre with these memorable characters.
“Superior Donuts” is not only a love letter to Chicago’s Uptown neighborhood but also a world you don’t mind spending a little more time in.
It's a smart and minor-key slice of life that allows the characters to connect.
Superior Donuts is a warm-hearted story with a positive ending and a cast of neighborhood characters who stop in each day.
This is one to place on your MUST SEE list!

For those that like laugh out loud comedies, human interest plays, plays set in Chicago, and ones that involve both self-reflection and solving external conflicts, Superior Donuts would be a good fit for you!
SUPERIOR DONUTS is well worth seeing, in fact a delight.

cn.t: Letts' heartwarming Chicago story about unlikely friendship in a donut shop earns praise for strong performances and authentic local flavor, though critics note the 2008 play feels dated and less substantial than the playwright's weightier works.
